line: Welcome, welcome, welcome to the Meridian Mall! Tonight's main event: one courier, one atrium, and a whole lot of hungry neighbours.
It's an arena, Parker. Don't fight it. Run through it.
Release the Hollows!
Those ones jump. Watch the ledges above you, not the floor.
Every shot rings the dinner bell. Make them count.
And he's into the food court, folks. Sadly, the food court is closed. Permanently.
This segment is brought to you by the Ward. Clean water, for people who know their place.
He made it to the anchor store! Ladies and gentlemen, I have never been so annoyed to be entertained.
Department store. Roof hatch is on the top floor, back corner. Go up.
Big ones with the scrap shields. Get round them, or hit them where the shield isn't.
That drone's painting you for the shooters. Knock it down.
Now, Parker, while you're browsing, a word from our... what is that? Who's on my frequency?
Keep the porch light on, courier. I'm coming home.
Technical difficulties, folks. Nobody touch anything.
That was her.
That was her. She's alive, and she's in his wires. Now run.
Our courier's on the roof. And guess who's waiting for him on the car park? An old friend.
Juno. She ran the Line with you, Parker. She knows every trick you've got.
Hey, Parker. Long time. Still running for other people?
Still running.
Those ones run like you do. They'll come at you from the side. Keep moving.
You were always the fast one. I was always the one who got paid.
Folks, it's the rematch nobody asked for and everybody wants!
Come on, then. Show the city.
Go on. Get her. Before I change my mind.
...She was one of ours, once. Keep going.
Well. Our ratings are through the roof, and every single one of you is cheering for the wrong man.
Let's take a short break for a word from our sponsor.
Port Calder. This is Commander Vell of the Ward. This broadcast has become a public safety concern. We'll be resolving it.
Parker. Those aren't raiders.
The channels run straight to the west side. The Ward owns them. The Ward owns the water. Be quick.
Back on the air, Port Calder, with our generous sponsors watching. Parker, darling, please die quietly.
Fresh orange. That's not mine. Somebody out there's marking you a route.
Courier sighted. Squad two, close the sluice line.
They work in teams and they don't miss twice. Don't stand still for them.
Helmets. First shot knocks it off, the second one counts.
The big Hollow's armoured on the front. Get behind it.
Folks, a reminder from our sponsor that water is a privilege. Parker is drinking it right now. Without paying.
The courier is not to reach the tower. Whatever it costs.
You heard the man. Whatever it costs. I'll send him the bill.
The old train line. It's the last straight road to the tower.
New rules tonight, Port Calder! I'll be changing the route live. Let's see how our courier likes improv.
Oh dear. Section nine. Gone. What a shame.
Drones with guns. They flash before they fire. One hit drops them.
Left at the junction, courier. Left. The right line ends in the sky.
Who keeps doing that?
Host, you were paid to end this.
And I was paid to make it entertaining, Commander. I'm doing both.
There's the tower. Go up it, kid.
Ten minutes, Port Calder. Ten minutes until our courier runs out of tower, and his wife runs out of luck.
I'm coming, Echo.
Don't look down. Do look up. That's where they're shooting from.
Hi, Port Calder. This is Echo. He's lying to you. He's been lying to you for twenty years.
Cameras are mine now. Look at him go.
Get her off my uplink! GET HER OFF!
The gun drones just went dark. She did that. Climb, Parker!
Three minutes! Two! I'm not even counting properly anymore!
Fine. Come in. The studio's open. Mind the step.
The studio's on the top floor. Everything he's got is between you and her.
Port Calder, this is it. The final segment. Please hold your applause until he's dead.
The armoured ones are slow. Don't trade with them. Get past.
Parker, the vents. Behind the transmitter. I left them open for you.
All units to the studio. This ends tonight.
Echo.
You're late.
Traffic.
Oh, I do love a reunion. Here's my favourite part.
Port Calder, I give you: the grand finale.
Parker! Parker, you're pinned. The whole floor's on fire.
Draw him off me. Run. I'll talk you down.
Line camp to anyone listening. They're home. Both of them.
Port Calder, this is Echo and Parker on the tower frequency. The show's over.
Go outside. It's a nice day.
Not bad, courier. Not bad.
